objective: Build ABG Pulse into a dependable, thorough and auditable corporate-intelligence PWA that lets a senior ABG user understand, in under 60 seconds, what materially changed across the Group, promoter family, companies, brands and senior leadership; why it matters; what may become important next; and whether to act, watch or ignore—with every factual claim traceable to evidence.

measurement.formula: Overall completion = sum(milestone weight × verified completion) / 100.
rules: A milestone percentage moves only when its acceptance evidence exists.
Designed but unconnected infrastructure does not count as operational.
A passing unit test does not count as real-world dependability proof.
Externally blocked work remains visible and is never marked complete.
The 30-day validation milestone cannot be accelerated by assertion.

availableNow.name: Product architecture and orchestration
availableNow.detail: Specification, milestone design, engineering sequencing, QA and red-team review can be executed here.

availableNow.name: Code build and automated testing
availableNow.detail: The application, APIs, data model, tests, QA renders and deployable packages can be built and tested.

availableNow.name: Public-web and official-source research
availableNow.detail: Official company pages, public disclosures, public news discovery and open sources can be researched and integrated.

availableNow.name: GitHub and Vercel connectors
availableNow.detail: GitHub is the source of truth and the connected Vercel production project now auto-deploys main. GitHub Actions independently verifies the public homepage, health endpoint, live scan and Job Meter after deployment.

availableNow.name: n8n workflow design
availableNow.detail: Importable workflows can be built, tested structurally and handed off. Running them continuously requires an authorised n8n instance.

availableNow.name: Database design
availableNow.detail: Supabase/Postgres schema, migrations and seed data can be produced. A live database requires project credentials or an authorised connector.

externalDependencies.name: Production hosting authorisation
externalDependencies.requiredFor: Verified public deployment, logs, environment variables and rollback
externalDependencies.ownerAction: None. GitHub-to-Vercel deployment and external endpoint verification are operational.

externalDependencies.name: Persistent database
externalDependencies.requiredFor: Shared history, claim-level evidence, corrections, watchlists, audit logs and multi-user continuity
externalDependencies.ownerAction: Authorise a Supabase/Postgres project or approved equivalent.

externalDependencies.name: Running n8n instance
externalDependencies.requiredFor: Scheduled ingestion, retries, alert routing and workflow observability
externalDependencies.ownerAction: Provide or authorise an n8n workspace.

externalDependencies.name: Licensed social-listening access
externalDependencies.requiredFor: Broad X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube-comment and closed-platform public sentiment
externalDependencies.ownerAction: Procure or authorise a licensed provider only after a coverage-gap and value test.

externalDependencies.name: Licensed premium/print/broadcast sources
externalDependencies.requiredFor: Closed, print-only, premium and broadcast coverage beyond public indexing
externalDependencies.ownerAction: Add only where live miss-testing proves a material gap.

externalDependencies.name: Elapsed validation time
externalDependencies.ownerAction: None; the platform must operate and be measured for 30 actual days.

milestones.title: Objective, constitution and quality gates
milestones.outcome: One unambiguous objective, scope, operating rules and release definition govern every build decision.
milestones.acceptanceGate: Product charter, evidence-first rules, world-class UX standard and measurable release gates are documented.
evidence: World-class standard translated into product rules
milestones.nextAction: Keep the objective immutable; revise only through explicit governance.

milestones.title: Complete ABG entity and stakeholder graph
milestones.outcome: All material companies, subsidiaries, brands, promoter family, boards, CEOs, CFOs, senior leaders and stakeholders are recognisable with effective dates and relationships.
milestones.acceptanceGate: 42/42 official company entries plus statutory subsidiaries, material brands, boards and current leadership are reconciled with aliases, jurisdictions, effective dates and ownership relationships.
milestones.nextAction: Add legal subsidiaries, JV ownership, company boards, subsidiary CEOs/CFOs, international leaders, role history and automated change detection.

milestones.title: Comprehensive source and rights universe
milestones.outcome: Every priority entity has authoritative, major-media, specialist, regional, international and public-conversation source coverage with legal-use rules.
milestones.acceptanceGate: Each priority entity is mapped to direct source endpoints, language, geography, cadence, rights status, owner lineage and fallback coverage.
milestones.nextAction: Add direct BSE/NSE/regulator/rating/SEC feeds, priority-company endpoints, multilingual and source-lineage governance.
milestones.dependency: Public endpoints; licensed feeds where proven necessary

milestones.title: Direct authoritative ingestion
milestones.outcome: Official, exchange, regulator, court, rating and company sources are checked directly instead of relying on media pickup.
milestones.acceptanceGate: Tier-0 sources are fetched, parsed, timestamped, health-checked and anomaly-monitored with PDF/attachment extraction where permitted.
evidence: Live-on-demand Google News and GDELT discovery
milestones.nextAction: Implement exchange/regulator/SEC/rating adapters, PDF parsing, pagination and content-change monitoring.
milestones.dependency: Stable source access and rights compliance

milestones.title: Persistent data and n8n orchestration
milestones.outcome: The platform maintains shared history, scheduled scans, retries, queues and alert delivery across users and devices.
milestones.acceptanceGate: Supabase/Postgres and n8n run in production with idempotent ingestion, queue replay, shared state, backups and observable failures.
milestones.nextAction: Connect an authorised database and n8n workspace; run migrations; activate schedules and retry paths.

milestones.title: Claim-level evidence, corrections and audit
milestones.outcome: Every factual statement can be reconstructed from immutable evidence, while contradictions, updates, corrections and retractions propagate everywhere.
milestones.acceptanceGate: Article snapshots, claims, evidence links, source lineage, contradictions, editorial decisions and correction versions are populated operationally.
evidence: Facts and interpretation separated in the UI
milestones.nextAction: Populate claim/evidence tables from live ingestion, add contradiction resolution, correction workflow and propagation tests.
milestones.dependency: Persistent database and full permitted source content

milestones.title: Entity resolution, deduplication and event lifecycle
milestones.outcome: Many reports become one accurate evolving event, with false matches and false merges kept near zero.
milestones.acceptanceGate: Contextual entity matching, source lineage, semantic event clustering and Emerging→Confirmed→Corrected→Closed lifecycle pass blind and adversarial tests.
milestones.nextAction: Add semantic and claim-level clustering, cross-language matching, update lineage, entity confidence and hard-negative benchmarks.

milestones.title: Decision-grade intelligence models
milestones.outcome: Materiality, trends, media tone, observed public sentiment, narrative drift and forecasts are transparent, calibrated and useful.
milestones.acceptanceGate: Scores are entity-specific, multilingual where required, sample-size aware, historically calibrated and graded against real outcomes.
evidence: Media Tone distinct from public sentiment
milestones.nextAction: Build labelled datasets, human-coded sentiment benchmark, narrative timelines, Google Trends/search-interest enrichment and prediction calibration.
milestones.dependency: Historical/live corpus; licensed social data for broad public sentiment

milestones.title: World-class daily-use experience
milestones.outcome: A senior user understands what matters with minimal mental energy and completes the briefing in under 60 seconds.
milestones.acceptanceGate: Mobile-first experience passes senior-user usability, accessibility, speed, comprehension and repeat-use tests with ≤60-second median completion.
milestones.nextAction: Reduce card density, run real target-user tests, add role-specific briefs, cross-device Watching and measured habit-loop analytics.
milestones.dependency: Target-user testing and persistent user state

milestones.title: Security, access, alerts and governance
milestones.outcome: Only authorised users see sensitive intelligence, critical alerts are governed and every intervention is accountable.
milestones.acceptanceGate: SSO/RBAC, rate limits, secret rotation, editorial roles, critical-alert approval, privacy/retention and rights governance are active and tested.
milestones.nextAction: Select identity provider, implement RBAC and editorial workflow, add rate limiting, alert routing and security testing.
milestones.dependency: Approved identity provider, hosting access and organisational governance owner

milestones.title: Production deployment, observability and recovery
milestones.outcome: ABG Pulse is reliably available, measurable, recoverable and safe to share.
milestones.acceptanceGate: Public/private production deployment, logs, health endpoints, uptime, alerts, rollback, backup restore and disaster recovery are independently verified.

milestones.title: 30-day independent dependability benchmark
milestones.outcome: The platform earns—not claims—9–10/10 dependability, thoroughness and executive trust.
milestones.acceptanceGate: 30 consecutive days show 100% critical-event recall in the reference set, ≥98% high-event weighted recall, 0 unsupported material claims, 0 silent Tier-0 outages and trusted daily use.
milestones.nextAction: Begin the shadow run after production ingestion, persistence and observability are live.
